title: ResultPackage v1
description: Result of exactly one Attempt. It repeats the full attempt-authority tuple, pins the stage-registry version and references the standalone StageResult resource urn:auditmanager:analysis:stage-result:v1 instead of defining its own copy of those rules. The engine never writes canonical metadata; publication happens in the control plane after schema, checksum, manifest and current-attempt validation.

attempt_authority.description: Complete authority tuple echoed back for exactly one Attempt. AuditRun, Job and Attempt are distinct (PD-03, approved with modification on 2026-09-01 by the repository owner). The engine echoes the tuple it received; it never mints a run_id, and no retry, resume, restart or worker failover turns one Run into another - each of those four reuses the job_id and mints exactly one new Attempt. Minting is a control-plane act: a change of inputs, an explicit re-audit and a repeat of a terminal Run under a NEW idempotency key each produce a NEW Run with its own run_id, while the same idempotency key with the same payload ALWAYS returns the existing Run and mints nothing at all, even when that Run is already terminal. A terminal Run is never reopened and keeps its run_id and terminal state forever. All nine creation cases, the complete per-trigger outcome tuple creates_run/reuses_existing_run/reuses_job/creates_attempt/reopens_terminal_run, and the precedence of RC-02 over RC-05 for a same-key same-payload repeat of a terminal Run, are enumerated machine-readably in stage-registry.json run_lifecycle, which is the authoritative form; this description restates that block in full and never extends it. execution_token is an opaque equality-only capability refreshed on every new Attempt; the control plane verifies it inside the publishing transaction, so a result whose tuple is not the current Attempt is rejected and never published. Fencing is a property of that behaviour, not of the field name.

stage_results.description: One entry per attempted registry stage. Every entry is validated by the standalone StageResult contract; this schema keeps no second copy of the status/error rules.

usage_summary.description: Explicit cost accounting. Absent usage is reported as zero, never omitted.

stage_result.title: StageResult v1
stage_result.description: Fail-closed result of exactly one canonical registry stage inside one Attempt. failed, partial and skipped require a typed error; succeeded forbids any error state.

artifact.description: Content-addressed artifact reference. It never carries an object key, URL, presigned link, credential or secret.

logical_name.description: Display-only label. It is never identity and never a filesystem path, object key or URL.

error.description: Typed reason carrier. For skipped it names the skip reason and is not retryable.

details.description: Safe scalar diagnostics only. It never carries a filesystem path, object key, URL, credential, execution or authority token, prompt, model payload or raw protected content. Consumers align the key allowlist with the domain error catalog safety rules.
